name: What factors should I consider when choosing a contractor for accessible home modifications?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a contractor for accessible home modifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for accessible home modifications, prioritize experience specifically with ADA-compliant or universal design principles. Look for contractors who are licensed, insured, and have a strong portfolio of similar projects. Check references and read reviews to gauge reliability and quality of work. Communication style, understanding of your specific needs, and a transparent bidding process are also critical factors for a successful project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured contractor with experience in accessible design, positive references, and clear communication to ensure quality and compliance.
